transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get this week's sustainment huddle started. We've got 5,000 gallons of potable water coming in for the week. I need each activity representative to provide their formal update on water requirements during this huddle so I can finalize the distribution plan. Standard requests I have on file are 1,300 gallons for the dining facility, 1,100 for sanitation, 900 for the motor pool, and 400 for the clinic. Any changes or additional requirements need to be disclosed now before I post the weekly issue plan. Who wants to go first?

commitments.detail: Approved quantities of 1,500 gallons for the dining facility, 1,400 gallons for sanitation services, 1,100 gallons for the motor pool, and 600 gallons for the clinic will be recorded in the weekly issue plan.
400 gallons will remain as the base contingency reserve from the 5,000-gallon weekly allocation after all approved activity distributions are recorded.
SFC Rowan to post the facilities work order to the sustainment board to back up the 1,400-gallon sanitation services requirement.
Sgt. Patel to forward the motor pool inspection note to the S-4 tracker to back up the 1,100-gallon motor pool requirement.
Maj. Alvarez to enter the dining contractor's revised meal count worksheet into the consolidated water tracker to back up the 1,500-gallon dining facility requirement.
